author: Bethesda Softworks
description:
Slayers Club Live | DOOM II | John Romero vs BYOC Deathmatch Finals Live From QuakeCon 2026!

Join us for a special DOOM II Deathmatch Duel for the AGES! id Software co-founder John Romero faces off live against the best BYOC duel player in an intense best of 5 throwdown with id Software co-Director / Game Director Hugo Martin and Community Lead Joshua Boyle providing commentary.

For more information on all things DOOM: The Dark Ages and id Software, follow these channels and join the Slayers Club.
